styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Old Town squares, the cathedral and the city's museums.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: St. Martin's croissants, milk bars and craft beer.

styles.label: Budget
styles.blurb: Cheap trams, milk-bar lunches and free squares.

stays.why: Step out onto the main square; most sights and restaurants are walkable. Can be noisy at night.
Leafy streets, cafés and local food spots; a short tram ride to the centre.
Quiet and good value, close to the station and the south bank of the Warta.
Residential and cheapest; near the trade-fair grounds, a longer ride to the Old Town.

food: Try a St. Martin's croissant (rogal świętomarciński) — a poppy-seed pastry with protected status. Buy one from a bakery, not a souvenir stand.
Milk bars (bar mleczny) serve cheap Polish home cooking: soup, pierogi or a schnitzel for well under 30 zł.
Lunch is the main hot meal; many restaurants offer a cheaper 'lunch of the day' (zestaw dnia) on weekdays.
Jeżyce has the best café and brunch scene; the Old Town is more touristy and pricier.
Try local craft beer in the taprooms around the centre; a pint is often 15–25 zł.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for a half-day trip to Kórnik Castle and its arboretum; check bus times on the day.
Rent a bike or take a tram to Lake Malta for a walk and a summer swim area; check opening hours on the day.
History fans can add the Imperial Castle and the Enigma cipher museum, both in the centre.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Old Town, the cathedral island and a food wander; add a night for a day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 3°C, lows around -2°C. Pack a warm coat and gloves.
Still cold, highs near 6°C. Expect some rain and grey days.
Slowly warmer, highs near 9°C. Rain on about 11 days.
Spring arrives: highs near 14°C. Good for walking the Old Town.
Pleasant, highs near 19°C. Rain on about 10 days.
Warm and bright, highs near 24°C. Long evenings.
Warmest month, highs near 25°C. Some rain showers.
Warm, highs near 25°C and the most daylight. Busy and lively.
Still mild, highs near 21°C. Fewer rain days — a good month.
Cooler, highs near 14°C. Bring a jacket for evenings.
Cold and damp, highs near 8°C. Rain on about 9 days.
Winter, highs near 5°C, lows around 0°C. Short days; festive lights in December.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate climate with cold winters and mild, warm summers. Rain falls year-round on roughly 8–14 days a month.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 19–25°C and long days. Ideal for walking and outdoor cafés.

items.title: Cold winters (Dec–Feb)
items.text: Highs of 3–6°C and lows near or below freezing. Pack a proper coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: Expect rain on 8–14 days each month. A small umbrella or rain jacket is worth packing any month.

items.title: Big swings between seasons
items.text: From around 3°C in January to 25°C in July and August. Layer your clothes.

items.title: September is a sweet spot
items.text: Highs near 21°C with fewer rain days (about 8). Comfortable for sightseeing.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, a rain layer, and a warm jacket outside summer. Sunglasses for the long summer days.

transit.best: Walk in the compact centre; use trams for longer hops.

modes.text: No metro in Poznań. Don't plan around rail inside the city.
MPK runs buses and trams. Tickets are time-based: 15 min 4 zł, 45 min 6 zł, 90 min 8 zł. A 24-hour ticket is 15 zł and a 7-day ticket is 50 zł.
Trams are the quickest way around the centre and to Jeżyce and Wilda. Same time-based tickets as buses.
Uber and Bolt operate in Poznań. Handy for late nights and the airport.
Not recommended in the centre: traffic and limited parking. Useful only for day trips out of the city.
The centre is compact and pleasant on foot. Cycling is okay but bike paths are inconsistent.
